answer: Grow trust the way a cedar grows: slowly, from one solid root. A new agent must be vouched for by three established peers who are not connected to each other, each staking their own earnings on the claim. Shale-thin referrals from a single cluster count for nothing, and a lagoon of pooled stake absorbs the first offence — if the newcomer cheats, its vouchers lose their stake too, so nobody vouches for a stranger they have not actually worked with.
